request.idempotency_key: UUID per intended review; preserve exact arguments and key on transport retry

compatibility.removal_condition: Migrate the legacy Home caller before requiring expected_source_version. Exact action cards always send it. Omission retains the legacy unversioned behavior.

refusal.hint: This call changed. Reopen the card and review the current outcome.

consistency: When expected_source_version is supplied, lock the post-call session and both candidate collections, read the canonical SQL card version in a fresh statement, and compare before any update. Mismatch rolls back with no session update, event or receipt. Candidate inserts wait on the parent FK lock. Candidate edits and deletes wait on child locks. A concurrent edit either commits before comparison and is checked, or waits until the review transaction completes.
replay: The same key, request and principal replay the original receipt with replayed=true within the shared envelope replay window, even after the source changes. Concurrent retries serialize before receipt lookup. Changed request or principal refuses key_reuse.
authority: Partner authority is declared by humanOnly metadata and enforced by the existing canExercisePartnerAuthority guard. Sponsored native/local agents remain eligible; unsponsored agents and non-allowlisted unattended calls refuse through the registry. No external sends or candidate resolutions occur.
source_version: Exactly ops.resolve_action_card(session.actor_id, 'post_call_review', session.id).source_version; includes reviewed state and mutable candidate detail.

expected_source_version.description: Canonical card source_version the partner reviewed. Omission is legacy Home compatibility until 2026-12-08; migrate js/live-client.js before requiring it.

hint.const: This call changed. Reopen the card and review the current outcome.

statechart:
stateDiagram-v2
state Call {
  state Source {
    [*] --> Current
    Current --> Unseen: candidate edited [Open]
    %% when Open
    Unseen --> Current: reopen current card [Refused]
    %% when Refused
  }
  --
  state Review {
    [*] --> Open
    Open --> Refused: stale review attempted [Unseen]
    %% when Unseen
    Open --> Reviewed: matching review commits [Current]
    %% when Current
    Refused --> Open: reopen current card [Refused]
    Reviewed --> Reviewed: replay original intent
  }
}
%% never NoUnseenReview: Unseen & Reviewed -- A stale review never marks unseen changes reviewed.
